summary: Main pit-timing tick: accumulates the elapsed frame time into per-vehicle pit timers, triggers pit-stall proximity checks (and car-lighting refresh) when a timer passes its threshold, dispatches a round-robin slice of 12 vehicle slots per frame to sub_4B6190, processes queued session-data messages through a ring buffer with a type-switch, and fires a pit-stop action when the recorded pit time has elapsed. The whole update is gated by a disable byte at this+0xF78.

local_names.this: pit timing/manager object (timers, round-robin state, per-vehicle threshold)
local_names.v14: elapsed time from embedded performance counter

operations.description: If the byte at this+0xF78 (offset 3960) is non-zero the entire pit-timing update is skipped.
When the count argument a3 is non-zero, VehicleInstanceListBuilder rebuilds the vehicle instance list from this.
PerformanceCounterDiffWithScaling reads the elapsed time from the timer embedded in this at offset 3372 into v14.
Time gate: the update proceeds only when the elapsed time exceeds 0.025 seconds and the input a4 differs from the previous value stored at this+0xD78 (offset 3448) by more than 0.001.
TimerResetUsingQueryPerformanceCounter resets the embedded timer in this at offset 3372 once the time gate passes.

Over the first dword_5C329C (0x005C329C) vehicles, accumulate the elapsed time v14 into each per-vehicle timer at this+0xD7C (offset 3452); a timer is reset to 0.0 and the proximity path runs when it exceeds the threshold at this+0xF7C (offset 3964).
On a timer threshold exceed, SetupCarLightingAndRender and PitStallProximityCheck are invoked for the affected vehicle.
Round-robin vehicle maintenance: from the step counter at this+0xD28 (offset 3368), call sub_4B6190 for every 12th slot below 104, then advance the counter (this+0xD28) by 1 modulo 12.
Store the current input a4 into this+0xD78 (offset 3448) as the previous value for the next frame's delta check.
Session-message processing: when the count in a2 is positive, SessionDataCopy snapshots the session data, then AdvanceRingBuffer is called repeatedly to pull messages into the local v15 buffer.

Message type dispatch: switch on (v15[0] >> 29) via the jump table at 0x004B7C60 (jpt_4B7BDF); types 2, 3, 4 and 6 always run PitStallProximityCheck, type 1 only when the sub-field ((v15[0] >> 18) & 0x3F) is non-zero and not 7.

Pit-stop action trigger: compute v12 from the pit-stall fields at this+0x9B0 (offset 2480) and this+0x9B8 (offset 2488) as base + 176 * index; when v12 is non-null and the pit time (threshold at this+0xF7C plus the +108 pit-target time) is not beyond a4, PitstopActionSet fires.

clean_pseudocode: for (i = this[0xD28]; i < 104; i += 12) sub_4B6190(this, i);
case 2: case 3: case 4: case 6: PitStallProximityCheck(this, v15, a4); break;
if (v12 && this[0xF7C] + v12[27] <= a4) PitstopActionSet(this, a4);

The per-vehicle timer accumulator array at this+0xD7C is bounded by dword_5C329C (VehicleCount); the exact layout and stride semantics of the pit-stall scratch buffer v15 are only partially visible in the raw source.
